title: 재외공관 무관주재령 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1

Article 5 (Selection and Appointment of Stationed Military Attaches)
(1) The Minister of National Defense shall select and appoint stationed military attaches from among persons who volunteer, upon recommendation by the Chiefs of Staff of the Army, Navy and Air Force (hereinafter referred to as "each armed service"; in the case of the Marine Corps, referring to the Commandant of the Marine Corps; hereinafter the same shall apply), the heads of agencies directly under the Ministry of National Defense, the Administrator of the Defense Acquisition Program Administration, etc.: Provided, That where necessary to accomplish a special purpose, the Minister of National Defense may designate, select and appoint a person.
(2) The Minister of National Defense may establish and operate a Selection Deliberation Committee for Stationed Military Attaches for the purpose of selection under paragraph (1).
(3) Qualifications and detailed selection procedures for stationed military attaches, the composition and operation of the Selection Deliberation Committee for Stationed Military Attaches, and other necessary matters shall be determined by the Minister of National Defense.
